scope: Closed stand-in for WFA-0058 vocabulary + WFA-0059 incidence. Those catalog artifacts are absent on this worktree; this file is the operator's input, not a forged WFA-0058 receipt.

mechanisms.name: Mechanism-level conflict refuse
mechanisms.definition: Refuse a union when the source workflows carry a mechanism-level conflict. A conflict is a closed vocabulary identifier clash, not a string mismatch.
examples: fusion of two workflow graphs aborted after a closed identifier clash on the vocabulary
composition stopped because the sources already conflicted at mechanism granularity
the operator refused a union after a vocabulary identifier clash not a stage title mismatch

mechanisms.name: Union guard on mechanism conflict
mechanisms.definition: A union is refused when source workflows already carry a mechanism-level conflict; conflict means a closed vocabulary identifier clash rather than a string mismatch.
examples: two workflow graphs were not fused due to a closed identifier clash
granularity of the mechanism conflict blocked composition of the sources
stage titles matched but a vocabulary identifier clash still refused the union

mechanisms.name: SBAR clinical handoff
mechanisms.definition: Situation Background Assessment Recommendation structures a clinical transfer of patient care between outgoing and incoming clinicians on a ward.
examples: night-shift nurse delivers situation and background then assessment to the incoming clinician
patient-care transfer note uses the recommendation slot before the outgoing nurse leaves the ward
clinician handoff on the ward follows situation background assessment recommendation order

mechanisms.name: Editorial peer review
mechanisms.definition: Independent referees evaluate a manuscript against written editorial criteria before a journal accepts the paper for publication.
examples: two referees return accept-with-revisions on a methods manuscript
journal editor withholds publication until independent referee reports arrive
editorial criteria are applied by referees before the paper is accepted

mechanisms.name: Quorum consensus
mechanisms.definition: A distributed replica group commits a value only after a quorum of voting replicas acknowledges the proposal.
examples: five replicas wait for three acknowledgements before committing the proposal
a minority partition cannot commit because quorum is not reached

mechanisms.name: Jury instruction
mechanisms.definition: A judge reads binding legal instructions that constrain how jurors may weigh admitted evidence before deliberation.
examples: the judge instructs jurors to ignore stricken testimony before they deliberate
binding legal instructions constrain how the jury weighs admitted exhibits

mechanisms.name: Delphi forecasting
mechanisms.definition: Iterated anonymous expert rounds with controlled feedback converge a forecast without requiring face-to-face debate.
examples: round-two anonymous forecasts shift after seeing the round-one median
experts never meet; the facilitator only returns aggregated feedback

mechanisms.name: Echo copy of a single blog claim
mechanisms.definition: A restated copy of one upstream blog post, repeated across many artifacts that share that single source.
examples: the same blog paragraph is pasted into a tenth derived note
twelve restatements still cite one upstream post and no other source

mechanisms.name: Rare high-impact kill-switch
mechanisms.definition: A kill-switch that aborts an entire multi-agent run when a safety invariant fails, attested by independent incident reports.
examples: the run aborts when the safety invariant fails even if the task is unfinished
three unrelated incident reports describe the same abort-on-invariant behaviour

mechanisms.name: Incident command
mechanisms.definition: A single incident commander holds span-of-control authority during an emergency and subordinates report through that chain.
examples: the incident commander assigns sector chiefs and no peer issues conflicting orders
span-of-control limits how many subordinates report directly to the commander

mechanisms.name: Air-traffic clearance
mechanisms.definition: A controller issues an exclusive clearance that a flight must read back before occupying a runway or flight level.
examples: the aircraft reads back the runway clearance before lining up
two flights cannot share a flight level without separate controller clearances

mechanisms.name: Two-person rule
mechanisms.definition: A sensitive action requires two authorised people present and independently confirming before the action proceeds.
examples: the vault does not open unless two authorised people independently confirm
a single operator present is not sufficient to complete the sensitive action
